name: Mud Brick (Adobe)
description: Traditional sun-dried mud brick with good thermal mass and moderate insulation, widely used in Ladakhi vernacular construction.

name: Rammed Earth
description: Compacted earth wall with high thermal mass; stores solar heat during the day and slowly releases it at night.

name: Concrete (Dense)
description: Standard dense concrete; high thermal mass but also high conductivity, leading to significant nighttime heat loss.

name: Stone (Granite)
description: Hard igneous rock with very high thermal conductivity; excellent thermal mass but poor insulator without added insulation.

name: Stone (Limestone)
description: Sedimentary rock commonly available in Himalayan regions; moderate conductivity and good thermal mass.

name: EPS Insulation (Polystyrene)
description: Expanded polystyrene foam board; excellent insulator with very low conductivity, lightweight, and easy to install.

name: Mineral Wool (Rock Wool)
description: Fibrous insulation made from volcanic rock; fire-resistant, moisture-tolerant, and provides good thermal and acoustic insulation.

name: Mud Brick + EPS Composite
description: Sandwich wall of mud brick outer/inner layers with EPS core; combines thermal mass with insulation for superior cold-climate performance.

name: Concrete + Mineral Wool Composite
description: Composite system of concrete structural layer with mineral wool insulation layer; durable and highly energy-efficient.

name: Trombe Wall (Dark Concrete)
description: Dark-painted high-mass concrete wall designed to absorb maximum solar radiation and slowly radiate heat inward over 6-12 hours.

name: Timber (Softwood)
description: Softwood timber; good insulator relative to masonry materials, lightweight, and locally available in some Himalayan regions.

name: Compressed Earth Block (CEB)
description: Machine-compressed stabilized earth blocks; more uniform and stronger than adobe with similar thermal properties.

name: Single Glazing
description: Single-pane glass window; allows high solar gain but has poor insulation, leading to significant nighttime heat loss.

name: Double Glazing
description: Double-pane insulated glass unit; significantly reduces heat loss compared to single glazing while maintaining good solar gain.

name: Polycarbonate Sheet
description: Multi-wall polycarbonate glazing panel; lightweight alternative to glass with better insulation and good light transmission.
